postings.title: Clinical Lead - Harrogate
postings.description:
We're hiring a RNLD Clinical Lead

Thornbury Community Services (part of Acacium Group)

Permanent, Full Time

Field based across North Yorkshire

£49,000-£53,000 + £3,000 car allowance

We are hiring a RNLD Clinical Lead to join Thornbury Community Services who are an 'outstanding' CQC-rated care provider that deliver complex care at home or in the community.

In this role you will manage a caseload of packages to support individuals with learning disabilities, autism and mental health needs.

In this role, you will:

- Undertake initial holistic nursing assessments and develop individualised care plans in partnership with the client, their family and the care team.

- Effectively communicate with the care team on the clinical condition or diagnosis and treatment or discharge plans of clients, ensuring accurate records are maintained.

- Identify and manage risks as part of care provision and lead the investigation and resolution of clinical incidents, ensuring timely and thorough documentation.

- Support the care team by delivering client-specific clinical training, mentorship and supervision by providing feedback, conducting performance reviews, and supporting professional development.

What we're looking for:

- A learning disabilities nurse with an active NMC pin

- Experience leading community teams to support individuals with learning disabilities, autism and mental health needs

- A valid drivers license and access to a vehicle

Your Benefits

- Your benefits package: Our company-funded benefits package includes employer pension contributions, life assurance and healthcare benefits, designed to support your financial wellbeing.

- Time to recharge: Enjoy 25 days’ annual leave plus Bank Holidays, with your holiday entitlement increasing with length of service.

- Flexible benefits to support you: Choose from a range of optional benefits including private medical insurance, critical illness cover, dental insurance, a healthcare cash plan, holiday buy and sell, a gym scheme, car scheme, bike scheme, technology voucher scheme and season ticket travel loans.

- Supporting your wellbeing: Access 24/7 wellbeing support for you and your immediate family, including an Employee Assistance Programme, digital wellbeing app and resources to support your mental, physical, social and financial wellbeing.

- Supporting you and your family: Receive discounted neurodevelopmental assessments for you and your loved ones.

- Save money every day: Enjoy instant discounts through our benefits platform on shopping, travel, entertainment, dining, lifestyle and much more.

- Grow your career: You’ll have access to fully funded professional qualifications through our apprenticeship programmes, mentoring and coaching, leadership development programmes, online learning and development opportunities and the chance to build your career across our global organisation, operating across four continents

- Recognition and community impact: We celebrate success through Long Service awards, exceptional performance and peer-to-peer recognition. You’ll also receive two paid volunteering days each year to support causes that matter to you.

About Acacium Group

Thornbury Community Services are part of Acacium Group, a global healthcare solutions partner providing staffing, managed services and innovative delivery models across the healthcare, social care and the life sciences industries. We are a business with scale and leading digital capabilities, with a vision to be the leading global healthcare solutions partner.

We are powered by our people and leading digital capabilities, working with our partners to improve access to healthcare and deliver better outcomes. Our values – Putting People First, Always by Your Side and Driven by Excellence – guide everything we do.

Join us and play a key role in shaping the future of society and improving people’s lives.

Inclusion and accessibility

We are committed to creating a truly inclusive and diverse workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and able to thrive. As an age-friendly and disability-confident employer, we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, communities and ages, recognising unique skills, experience and perspectives individuals bring at every stage of their career. Guided by our core value of Putting People First, we are committed to fostering an inclusive culture and will consider flexible working options and reasonable adjustments wherever possible to suit individual needs.

Support Worker within Learning Disability Services (Female only - must be a driver)

LOCATION: Middlesbrough, North Yorkshire

PAY RATES: £16.81 - £21.01 per hour (holiday pay inclusive)

Shifts - flexible and available to work across a variety of shifts, including days, nights, and weekends.

Make a lasting impact by building meaningful relationships.

At Thornbury Community Services (TCS), we believe exceptional care starts with genuine connections. We’re looking for Female Support Workers within Learning Disability Services who are committed to making a real difference—people who truly care and want to build long-term partnerships with those they support.

This isn’t just a job; it’s an opportunity to empower an individual with ADHD, Complex mood and emotional dysregulation & Challenging behaviour to live safe, fulfilled lives. You’ll help clients achieve personal goals, explore new hobbies, and enjoy trips into the community—all while creating relationships that bring lasting satisfaction for both you and them.

We are looking for a caring and dedicated Support Worker to support a bright, resilient and engaging young person with a great sense of humour. The role involves building a trusting relationship, encouraging independence, and supporting interests such as art, baking, cooking, education and community activities.

We are seeking someone who is kind, patient and reliable, with a passion for helping young people develop confidence, life skills and achieve their goals. This is a rewarding opportunity to make a genuine difference and support a young person to reach their full potential.

What You’ll Do

· Deliver person-centered care within the client’s own home.

· Maintain safety whilst making positive risk decisions.

· Enrich life and promote independence.

· Build trust and long-term relationships that make every day meaningful.

What We Offer

We value our support workers and provide a benefits package designed to help you thrive:

· Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) – confidential wellbeing support.

· Travel and mileage expenses – reimbursed for your shifts.

· Exceptional pay rates – among the highest in the UK.

· Bespoke training and competency development – keep growing in your career.

What We’re Looking For

We want passionate, resilient professionals who can commit to delivering care without exception. To join our team, you’ll need:

· 12 months UK-based experience in a community setting.

· Confidence in maintaining risk and using physical intervention where required.

· Confidence in utilising PBS standards within services.

· Strong personal values and ethical standards.

· Dedication, commitment and stability.

· A genuine desire to build lasting relationships and make a positive impact.

Why Choose TCS?

Joining Thornbury means joining a compassionate team that values people—not just as clients, but as individuals. You’ll enjoy job satisfaction, and the chance to make a difference that lasts.

Apply Today

Ready to start a role where care goes beyond tasks and becomes a relationship? Click Apply Now and our team will be in touch.

For questions, contact us at:

· Email: ldamhapplications@thornburycommunityservices.co.uk

· Phone: 0333 034 1135

postings.title: Mental Health Support Worker - Chester
postings.description:
Mental Health Support Worker 

Location: Wrexham

Contract Available:

- 36 Hours Per Week (3x 12 hour shifts) – £24,960 per annum

Make a Lasting Difference

Are you passionate about helping people live fulfilling and independent lives? We are looking for caring, committed, and enthusiastic Support Workers to join our Supported Living team, supporting eight individuals with mental health needs to achieve their goals, build confidence, and maintain their independence. As a Support Worker, you will play a vital role in empowering people to live independently within their home and local community. You will provide person-centered support that promotes wellbeing, recovery, choice, and inclusion.

Working as part of a dedicated team, you will support individuals to develop life skills, achieve personal outcomes, and manage their mental health in a positive and meaningful way

About the Role

As a Mental Health Support Worker, you will:

- Deliver high-quality, person-centered support within supported living services.

- Promote independence, wellbeing and positive outcomes.

- Support individuals with daily living activities, health management and life skills.

- Encourage social engagement and participation within the local community.

- Build positive, trusted relationships that help people achieve their personal goals.

- Work collaboratively with colleagues, families and other professionals to provide outstanding care.

What We're Looking For

We're seeking caring and resilient individuals who are passionate about supporting others.

Ideally, you'll have:

- Experience working within mental health, social care or a support environment.

- A person-centered approach and genuine passion for helping others.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

- The ability to remain calm, adaptable and positive in challenging situations.

- A commitment to promoting independence, dignity and choice.

- A full UK driving license (desirable but not essential).

Why Join Us?

We love exceptional people, and in return, we offer an exciting place to work with a wide range of benefits, rewards and opportunities to develop your career.

Career Development

- Dedicated support, guidance and career development to help you build a long and successful career.

- Endless learning and development opportunities, including fully funded qualifications.

Rewards and Benefits

- Pensions scheme, free mortgage broker service & life assurance

- Wellbeing Benefits. Employee Assistance Programme. Digital Health & Wellbeing App. Mental, Social, Physical & Financial Workshops

- Recognition Benefits. Long Service awards, Exceptional performance awards & Increasing holiday allowance

- Discounts. Shopping, lifestyle & cinema discounts

Apply Today

Start a career where compassion, connection and commitment make a real difference.

Apply now to join our Mental Health Support team in Wrexham.
